title: Cannabis Dependence Addiction
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals on a journey of recovery from cannabis
dependence. They encourage self-awareness, emotional resilience, healthy coping, and the

development of a balanced, purposeful life. Read each affirmation every morning and reflect on it
throughout the day as you continue your healing journey.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder: Recovery from cannabis dependence is possible with support. These affirmations complement counseling and trusted accountability.

modules.title: Awareness & Commitment
focus: I acknowledge my dependence without allowing it to define me.
I choose recovery one day at a time.
Every healthy decision moves me toward freedom.

modules.title: Healing & Self-Care
focus: My brain and body are healing every day.
I treat myself with patience, kindness, and compassion.
I am learning healthy ways to cope with life's challenges.

modules.title: Strength & Resilience
focus: Every challenge makes me more resilient.
I trust myself to continue making healthy choices.

modules.title: Freedom & Renewal
focus: I embrace clarity, purpose, and emotional balance.
Recovery is becoming my new way of life.
My future is filled with hope, growth, and possibility.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by cannabis or my past choices. I am defined by my courage, my resilience, and
my commitment to healing. Every day I choose recovery, I strengthen my mind, restore my body,
and reclaim my future. One day at a time, I am creating a life of clarity, purpose, peace, and lasting
freedom.
